threats.title: Certighost Exploit Lets Low-Privileged Active Directory Users Impersonate a Domain Controller
threats.summary: Researchers H0j3n and Aniq Fakhrul published a working exploit on July 24 that lets a low-privileged Active Directory user obtain a certificate for a Domain Controller and authenticate as that machine.
